block_config.title: Think Big, Start Small and Scale Fast
block_config.content:
The "Action Over Analysis" Philosophy
Too many great ideas die in the planning phase. We spend months building roadmaps for a terrain we haven't even stepped foot on yet. I believe the only way to validate a product is to build it, ship it, and break it.





How I Work:
Start with a hypothesis, not a Gantt chart.

Create value immediately. If it doesn't solve a problem today, it won't solve it in six months.

Embrace the unknown. The best features are often discovered after you start coding, not before.

I don't sell plans. I deliver momentum.
